picks.editorial_note: MIT's Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins won the 2026 Pritzker Prize for AI in Science Research Excellence, the field's top honor, for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery that combines deep learning with bioengineering to find new drugs against resistant pathogens.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge researchers used an AI-guided 'plug and play' technique to design a broad-spectrum bird flu vaccine that achieved complete protection against diverse variants in animal trials, a major step toward AI-designed vaccines for future pandemic threats.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: A Georgetown economist's analysis of SpaceX and Anthropic pledging billions in equity to the public (including up to $100B from Anthropic) spotlights an emerging policy debate over how AI windfall wealth should be distributed as frontier AI companies grow enormously valuable.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a five-year, $24.5 million NSF-funded national effort led by the Morgridge Institute to build shared AI research infrastructure for science — a significant federal investment in the nation's AI-for-science backbone.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: Boston University joined a $39.5 million ARPA-H consortium with Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell to develop AI-enabled robotic catheter technology for remote stroke surgery, pairing substantial federal funding with a cross-sector partnership aimed at a real clinical bottleneck.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC signed a strategic framework agreement anchored by HSBC's new AI & Emerging Technology Institute, extending a near three-decade relationship into a formal push on AI and financial innovation — a notable deepening of academia-industry ties in finance.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' developed with Fermilab, gives scientific machine-learning projects agentic tools for documentation, code review, and benchmarking — a concrete step in the federal Genesis Mission to accelerate AI-driven science nationally.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team will combine large-scale health data, satellite imagery, animal models, and AI to study how environmental exposures contribute to Alzheimer's and dementia, a well-resourced push to apply AI to a major public health question.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: ANU received Google.org funding through dedicated fusion-AI awards to modernize a widely used fusion simulation tool, a partnership that channels industry resources directly into accelerating clean-energy science.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely self-generated synthetic data rather than real-world data, a conceptually important result for how future models might be trained without data scarcity limits.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It
